svg.text: Asteroid Breaker uplift: pickups, motes and hazards
Concept art, drawn by lib/things.mjs. Shape says what each thing is before color does: an orb is round, a mote is a spark, the comet is a wedge with a tail, a burr is a seed in a whorl of hooks.
Every tone is a role of the palette or a mix of two.

Round is a friend, so each pickup is a glass ball 1.1 units in radius: a soft halo of the accent, a rim, a glint at the upper left where the field's light falls, and one bold symbol. The rim says what a

pickup is for without color: a weapon's is one ring, protection's is doubled, a field effect's is cut in four arcs. Each symbol has a silhouette of its own: three bolts fanning apart, two roofs, a slanted
arrow through a bar, a crest, a dart with a plus (a placeholder for the pod), a tilted horseshoe, an hourglass, a star.
field effect: a ring in four arcs
field effect: a ring in four arcs
field effect: a ring in four arcs
Now and after, in every palette

Today's pickup is a rounded hexagon in the accent with its symbol in thin lines; the orb is beside it. At 6 px a unit an orb is about 14 px across: the inner glint and the glass's second tone are left out, a
doubled rim becomes one thick rim, the Extra ship's plus goes and its dart fills the orb, and no line of a symbol is thinner than a pixel and a half.
6 px a unit: about 14 px across
6 px a unit: about 14 px across
6 px a unit: about 14 px across
6 px a unit: about 14 px across

At rest; breathing, between its own size and 7% larger, its halo with it; and blinking for its last 2 seconds, between whole and a faint ghost of itself with no halo, 2.5 times a second as today. Reduced
motion: no breath, and for its last 2 seconds it holds dim, without its halo, instead of blinking.

Tiny glowing bits a broken rock sheds and the ship gathers: a diamond at the smallest size and a four-point spark at the other two, in the accent, each in a small halo. They are sparks, so never rocks, and
too small and too still to be shots. Drawn in, each takes a curved path and leaves a short tail.
Drawn in to the ship, on curved paths
Drawn in to the ship, on curved paths

Pointed with a tail is fast and deadly. Its head is cut and lit as a rock is, but it is a long sharp wedge in the danger color, which no rock is; its leading edge glows; five streaks trail it, the middle one
hot; and thin lines beside it say 26 units a second. Under 10 px a unit the leading edge and half the thin lines are left out.
At 34 px a unit: a long wedge cut in eight facets, lit from the upper left, in a tail of streaks
At 22 px a unit, beside a large stone and today's comet
At 34 px a unit: a long wedge cut in eight facets, lit from the upper left, in a tail of streaks
At 22 px a unit, beside a large stone and today's comet

For 1.5 seconds before it comes: a bar on the edge it will come in by, three chevrons pointing the way it will fly, lit one after another, a step every 250 ms, so the run passes twice before it comes, and a

faint lane across the whole field, two units wide as the comet is, so the player sees where not to be. Reduced motion: the three chevrons hold, each fainter than the one before, which still points the way.
At the field's left edge, at 18 px a unit: a bar on the edge, three chevrons lit in turn, and a faint lane as wide as the comet
warned for 1.5 s, at 5 px a unit
At the field's left edge, at 18 px a unit: a bar on the edge, three chevrons lit in turn, and a faint lane as wide as the comet
warned for 1.5 s, at 5 px a unit

A hazard that harms nothing: a round seed, 0.6 units to its hooks' ends, in a whorl of thirteen thin spines, long and short by turns, each barbed the same way round. It clings to the ship and slows it until a

dash shakes it off. Its core is round and soft-lit, not cut, so it is no rock; its spines are thin barbed lines, not ice's flat shards; and it is a seed's dull brown, not the comet's red. Reduced motion:
a small stone, small ice, a burr, a mote
shaken off by a dash, 40 ms
shaken off by a dash, 150 ms
shaken off by a dash, 280 ms
